description_en: The UpgradeServiceInstance operation upgrades a service instance based on parameters such as the region ID and service version
description_zh: 使用地域ID、服务版本等参数调用UpgradeServiceInstance升级服务实例
kebab_example: aliyun computenestsupplier upgrade-service-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-5cbae874da0e47xxxxxx --service-version 2 --client-token 10CM943JP0EN9D51H --dry-run false --parameters param=value --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeServiceInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and must be no more than 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. A dry run checks for issues such as permission errors and instance status. Valid values:

true: Sends a dry run request to check whether the request is valid. The service instance is not upgraded.

false: Sends a regular request. The service instance is upgraded after the request passes the check
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次创建请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。可能的值：

true：发送请求，不创建服务实例。

false：发送请求，检查通过后创建服务实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The configuration parameters of the service instance
parameters.name: parameters

Status.description_en:
The deployment status of the service instance. Valid values:

Created: The service instance is created.

Deploying: The service instance is being deployed.

DeployedFailed: The service instance failed to be deployed.

Deployed: The service instance is deployed.

Upgrading: The service instance is being upgraded.

Deleting: The service instance is being deleted.

Deleted: The service instance is deleted.

DeletedFailed: The service instance failed to be deleted
Status.description_zh:
服务实例的部署状态。可能值：

Created：已创建

Deploying：部署中

DeployedFailed：部署失败

Deployed：已部署

Upgrading：升级中

Deleting：删除中

Deleted：已删除

DeletedFailed：删除失败

UpgradeRequiredParameters.description_en: The parameters that are required for the upgrade

items.description_en: The parameters that are required for the upgrade
